summary.text: No accepted slop-associated findings in the assessed scope. The page is a plain municipal catalog: a dark blue header naming the portal, an introduction that names the publishing office, the fields shown, and the license, a uniform grid of dataset cards each giving format, size, and update date, and a footer with a contact address and a style-guide note. The uniform card grid is present but recorded as a contextual exception, because the items are genuinely parallel dataset listings and the provided context documents a style-guide requirement for catalog cards. The footer contact uses a reserved documentation domain; it is also recorded as an exception rather than a finding, because the bundle is labeled a synthetic fixture and the address was not tested. Copy is specific, sizes carry units, the regions agree with each other, and captured styles show no gradients, shadows, decorative effects, or configured animation. The audit covers one desktop state with no interactions or source, and the card containers' own styles were not captured. It describes observable features only and makes no claim about how the page was made.
major_limitations: One desktop state at 1280x800 only; no mobile viewport, so responsive layout and mobile quality were not checked.
No interactions recorded: any links, download paths, or controls are untested. No anchor elements were captured, so whether dataset titles link anywhere is unknown.
No source excerpts supplied; SRC-01 is unassessed.
Card container (article) elements were not captured in the DOM; card borders and corner rounding are described from the screenshot only, and any card-level motion is unknown.
Context fields come from a capture plan labeled synthetic, not from the site's own documentation.
